errors.conflict: Someone else changed this while you were looking at it. Reload to see their version, then make your change again.
errors.noAccess: You need the platform permission {permission} for this.
errors.manifestInvalid: The manifest does not follow manifest v1. Each problem is listed with its path.
errors.recipeInvalid: The recipe does not follow the recipe format, or it does not match the manifest. Each problem is listed with its path.
errors.urlRefused: An address in the recipe is refused: {detail}.
errors.urlRefusedPlain: An address in the recipe is refused. Addresses must be https, a public DNS name, on the default port and without credentials.
errors.connectorNotAvailable: The {type} connector type is not implemented yet, so this listing cannot be published. Nothing that does not work reaches a workspace.
errors.slugTaken: Another listing or category already uses that id. Pick a different one.
errors.categoryGone: That category no longer exists. Reload the list.
errors.categoryUnknown: The category named in the manifest does not exist for this kind of app, or it is switched off. Pick one from the Categories page.
errors.categoryInUse: Apps are listed in this category. Move them to another category first, or switch the category off to hide it from workspaces.
errors.versionState: This is not allowed while the listing or version is {status}. Reload to see its current state.
errors.versionStatePlain: This is not allowed in the current state of the listing or version. Reload to see its current state.
errors.versionExists: The version number must be higher than {newest}, the highest version so far.
errors.versionExistsPlain: That version number already exists. Use a higher one.
errors.appUnavailable: A killed listing cannot be published. Restore it first, then publish.
errors.appNotFound: This listing does not exist. It may have been deleted.
errors.notFound: That item was not found. It may have been deleted.
errors.rateLimited: Too many requests. Wait {seconds} seconds and try again.
errors.rateLimitedPlain: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.validationFields: Some fields are not valid. Each problem is listed with its field.
errors.request: The request could not be completed.
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong on our side. Try again; if it keeps happening, quote the request id.

list.title: Marketplace catalogue
list.description: Every listing in any status: mini apps and integrations, their versions and how many workspaces have them installed.

kpi.label: Listings by status
kpi.note: Counts cover the {count} listings loaded so far, not the whole catalogue.
kpi.noteMore: More are available: use Load more.

filters.label: Filters
filters.categoryNote: Filters the listings already loaded: the API has no category filter.

list.emptyMessage: Create the first listing to start the catalogue.
list.noMatchMessage: Nothing matches these filters. Try different ones.
list.noMatchMoreMessage: None of the listings loaded so far match. More are available: load them, or change the filters.

new.title: New listing
new.description: Create a draft listing with its first version. Nothing reaches a workspace until a reviewer approves and publishes it.

sections.docsHelp: The manifest says who the app is, what it may do and which connector it uses. An integration also needs a recipe. Both are checked as you type, with the rules the server applies.
sections.changelogHelp: Shown to admins as what the first version contains.

new.changelogHint: Optional, up to {max} characters. Left empty, it reads First version.
new.draftNote: The listing starts as a draft. Submit its version for review from the listing page.

editor.problemCount: {count, plural, one {# problem to fix} other {# problems to fix}}

manifest.label: Manifest (JSON)
manifest.hint: Manifest v1: id, name, kind, category, version, description, scopes, pricing, support, connector.

recipe.label: Recipe (JSON)
recipe.hint: The connector recipe of an integration: connector, authFields, mapping, rateLimits, errorMapping, setupInstructions, testPayloads.

scopes.title: Permissions this version asks for
scopes.help: What an admin is asked to accept, in plain words. Ask for the fewest that work.

templates.title: Start from a template
templates.help: Fills both editors with a valid starting point that you then edit.
templates.replaceTitle: Replace what is in the editors?
templates.replaceBody: The manifest and recipe you typed will be replaced by the template.

problems.syntaxAt: Not valid JSON, near line {line}, column {column}.
problems.recipeNotAllowed: A mini app has no recipe: clear this editor.
problems.recipeMissing: An integration needs a recipe before it can be submitted for review.
problems.recipeConnectorMismatch: Must equal the manifest connector type: {expected}.
problems.idChanged: The id of an existing listing cannot change: it must stay {expected}.
problems.kindChanged: The kind of an existing listing cannot change: it must stay {expected}.
problems.versionNotHigher: The version must be higher than {newest}, the highest version so far.
problems.versionTaken: Another version of this listing already uses {version}.
problems.categoryUnknown: There is no active {kind} category {category}. Check the Categories page.
problems.categoryRefused: The server refused this category: it does not exist for this kind, or it is switched off.
problems.slugTaken: Another listing already uses this id.

sections.pageHelp: What an admin reads on the app page.
sections.screenshotsHelp: Up to {max} images shown on the app page. https links only.
sections.dataHelp: What the app stores, where, and how it is deleted: the statement shown on the app page.
sections.placementHelp: How it is ranked, and which plan can install it.

fields.logoHint: An https image link. An integration without one falls back to the logo in its recipe.
fields.longDescriptionHint: Plain text; blank lines separate paragraphs. Up to {max} characters.
fields.highlightsHint: One per line: up to {max}, each up to {length} characters.
fields.dataRegionsHint: Comma separated, up to {max}, for example India, EU.
fields.firstPartyHint: Built and run by us: shown with a first-party badge.
fields.planFeatureHint: A workspace needs this feature on its plan, or through an add-on, to install the app. Labels come from the plans catalogue.
fields.sortOrderHint: A whole number from 0 to {max}; lower shows first.

problems.number: Use a whole number from 0 to {max}.
problems.unknownFeature: Use lowercase letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter.
problems.slug: Use 2 to 48 lowercase letters, digits or dashes, starting with a letter.
problems.icon: Use 1 to 32 lowercase letters, digits or dashes.

summary.title: Fix these before saving
summary.sentTitle: The server did not save this
summary.manifest: {count, plural, one {# problem in the manifest} other {# problems in the manifest}}
summary.recipe: {count, plural, one {# problem in the recipe} other {# problems in the recipe}}
summary.fields: {count, plural, one {# problem in the listing fields} other {# problems in the listing fields}}

operate.title: Operate
operate.description: Hide, kill, restore or delete the listing. Each one asks for confirmation.
operate.lacking: Some actions are hidden because your roles do not include {permission}.

killed.title: This listing is killed
killed.effect: Every installation is stopped and every delivery address answers 410. Workspaces can only uninstall.

notice.killedBody: {count, plural, one {# installation was switched off.} other {# installations were switched off.}}
notice.publishedUpgraded: {count, plural, one {# installation moved to it at once.} other {# installations moved to it at once.}}
notice.publishedWaiting: {count, plural, one {# installation keeps its current version until its admin accepts the new permissions.} other {# installations keep their current version until their admins accept the new permissions.}}

edit.readOnly: Read only. Editing the listing needs the platform permission {permission}.
edit.conflict: Someone else saved this listing while you were editing it. Reload to see their version, then make your change again.

hide.title: Hide {name}?
hide.body: {name} leaves browse and search, so no new workspace finds it. Existing installations keep working.

unhide.title: Show {name} again?
unhide.body: {name} appears again in browse and search with its published version.

unkill.title: Restore {name}?
unkill.body: {name} becomes hidden so it can be fixed and published again. Installations that were killed stay off: workspaces must install it again.

delete.title: Delete {name}?
delete.body: This permanently deletes the draft listing and its versions. A listing that was published or installed cannot be deleted: hide it instead.

killDialog.title: Kill {name}?
killDialog.installs: {name} is installed in {count, plural, one {# workspace} other {# workspaces}}.

effects.stop: Every installation stops working at once.
effects.address: The delivery address answers 410 Gone from the next request on.

killDialog.undo: Restoring the listing later makes it hidden. Killed installations stay off and workspaces must install it again.
killDialog.reasonHint: Between {min} and {max} characters. It is kept in the audit trail and shown to each workspace.
killDialog.typeSlugHint: The id of the listing, exactly as shown.

versions.title: Versions
versions.description: Every version of this listing. Select one to see its manifest, recipe and actions.
versions.newVersionHint: A new version starts from the version you are viewing ({version}) with the number raised. It must be higher than every earlier version.
versions.selectedHelp: Its permissions, manifest and recipe as stored. The actions follow the version's state and your permissions.
versions.recipeMissing: This integration has no recipe yet. Add one before submitting for review.
versions.noRecipeIntegration: No recipe is stored for this version.
versions.noRecipeMiniApp: A mini app has no recipe.

versionEditor.newHelp: Starts from the version you were viewing, with the number raised. Change the manifest and recipe, then describe what changed.
versionEditor.editHelp: Replaces the manifest and recipe of this version. A rejected version goes back to draft when saved.
versionEditor.changelogHint: What changed in this version. Admins read it. Up to {max} characters.

approve.title: Approve {name} {version}?
approve.body: An approved version can then be published. Approving does not change what workspaces see.
approve.noteHint: Kept with the version. Up to {max} characters.

reject.title: Reject {name} {version}?
reject.body: The reason is shown to the developer. They edit the version and submit it again.
reject.noteHint: At least {min} and at most {max} characters.

publish.title: Publish {name} {version}?
publish.body: {name} {version} becomes the version every new installation gets.

effects.retire: The version published before is retired.
effects.moveSame: Installations whose granted permissions already cover this version move to it at once.
effects.moveMore: Installations it asks more of keep running on their current version until their admin accepts the new permission list.

publish.installs: {count, plural, one {# installation is affected.} other {# installations are affected.}}
publish.first: This is the first published version.
publish.addedScopes: {count, plural, one {It asks for # permission the published version does not:} other {It asks for # permissions the published version does not:}}

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: The categories of both Marketplace tabs. A category switched off is hidden from workspaces; one with apps in it cannot be deleted.
categories.emptyMessage: Add a category before creating listings: every listing belongs to one.
categories.groupEmpty: No categories for this kind yet.

form.slugHint: 2 to 48 lowercase letters, digits or dashes, starting with a letter. It cannot be changed later.
form.slugLocked: The id cannot be changed after creation.
form.name: Name
form.iconHint: Optional icon name: lowercase letters, digits and dashes.
form.sortOrderHint: A whole number from 0 to {max}; lower shows first.
form.activeHint: Switched off, the category is hidden from workspaces. Its apps keep it.
form.conflict: Someone else changed this category. Reload to see their version, then make your change again.

deleteDialog.title: Delete {name}?
deleteDialog.body: {name} has no apps. Deleting it removes it for good.

requests.title: Requests
requests.description: What workspaces asked for, most voted first. The build order follows this list.
requests.readOnly: Read only. Triage needs the platform permission {permission}.
requests.emptyMessage: When a workspace asks for an integration it appears here with its votes.

triage.title: Triage {name}
triage.noteHint: Optional, up to {max} characters. Only operators see it.
triage.conflict: Someone else updated this request. Reload to see their version, then make your change again.

usage.title: Usage and health
usage.description: Per app: installations by status and health, and deliveries accepted, repeated, rejected and failed in the last 24 hours and 7 days.
usage.emptyMessage: Apps appear here once they exist in the catalogue.

reasons.needsReauth: Installations that need to sign in again
reasons.failed24h: Failed deliveries in the last 24 hours
reasons.failed7d: Failed deliveries in the last 7 days

usage.recipeHint: The recipe may be breaking: a portal changed its format or a key expired. Fix it with a new version of the recipe.
usage.runbookNote: An integration with many installations in error or needing to sign in again, or a rising failed count, is breaking. Patch its recipe in a new version (runbook, section 8).
